annotations.title: utilpeek: make a QR code image (SVG or PNG)

description: utilpeek: make a QR code image. For 1-D barcodes use make_barcode; to read a code use read_qr_barcode. Returns `svg` (text) or `data_base64` (PNG), or with `output` "url" a 24 h download link, plus `version`, `modules`, `width_px`, `height_px` and `bytes`. Data too long for a QR code at the chosen level is a 422 (not charged). Encoded locally, nothing is fetched; typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/qr-code-api.html

data.description: Text or URL to encode (1-2000 characters, at most 2953 UTF-8 bytes).
data.title: Data

output.description: base64 (default): the file comes back inline as base64. url: the file is stored for 24 hours and the reply carries a download link (url, expires_at, bytes, content_type, sha256) instead of the base64, which keeps the file out of your context window.
output.title: Output

name: make_qr_code

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
